items.exampleEn: Please write down the measurements of the window.
items.exampleZh: 請把窗戶的尺寸記下來。

items.exampleEn: The hotel room was clean, and the price was moderate.
items.exampleZh: 飯店房間很乾淨，價格也適中。

items.exampleEn: The noise slowly decreased after midnight.
items.exampleZh: 午夜過後，噪音慢慢減少了。

items.exampleEn: The maximum speed on this road is fifty.
items.exampleZh: 這條路的最高速限是五十。

items.exampleEn: The minimum age for this job is eighteen.
items.exampleZh: 這份工作的最低年齡是十八歲。

items.exampleEn: We need a large quantity of paper for the event.
items.exampleZh: 這次活動我們需要大量的紙。

items.exampleEn: The sheer size of the building surprised us.
items.exampleZh: 光是那棟大樓的大小就讓我們很驚訝。

items.sentenceEn: This elevator can carry a maximum of ten people.
items.sentenceZh: 這部電梯最多可以載十個人。

items.audioEn: We had a decrease in sales this month, so we need a new plan.
items.audioZh: 我們這個月的銷售額下降了，所以需要新的計畫。

items.sentenceEn: Quality is more important than quantity.
We won the game through sheer hard work.
items.sentenceZh: 我們完全靠努力贏了這場比賽。

items.stemEn: Cook the soup over ____ heat for twenty minutes.
Please check the ____ of each item: we ordered ten, not twelve.
items.stemZh: 請核對每樣東西的數量：我們訂的是十個，不是十二個。

items.passageEn: Our coffee shop has a simple rule: quality over quantity. We buy only a moderate amount of fresh beans each week. Each cup is made with careful measurement, using a minimum of eighteen grams of coffee. The shop is small, with a maximum of twenty seats. Last winter, the number of customers decreased because of the cold, but our loyal customers still came. They say they come for the sheer joy of a good cup.
items.passageZh: 我們咖啡店有一條簡單的規則：品質比數量重要。我們每週只買適量的新鮮咖啡豆。每一杯都經過仔細的測量，至少用十八公克的咖啡。店面很小，座位最多二十個。去年冬天，因為天氣冷，客人變少了，但老客人還是會來。他們說，他們是純粹為了一杯好咖啡帶來的快樂而來。

questions.questionZh: 這家咖啡店的規則是什麼？
去年冬天發生了什麼事？

items.promptZh: 這個房間最多可以坐三十個人。
referenceEn: This room can hold a maximum of thirty people.
The room can seat a maximum of thirty people.
rubricZh: a maximum of＋數字，表示「最多⋯」
寫 up to thirty people 意思也正確

items.promptZh: 這個小鎮的人口在過去十年減少了。
referenceEn: The population of this town has decreased over the past ten years.
This town's population decreased in the last ten years.
rubricZh: 用 decrease 表示「減少」（例如 has decreased、decreased 等；寫 has gone down 也正確）
「過去十年」可寫，例如 over the past ten years、in the last ten years 等
